note: Strategy configuration for scripts/demo_trader.py auto mode. Deliberately DISABLED. To arm: (1) configure demo API-key secrets, (2) set KALSHI_ALLOW_TRADING=1, (3) set enabled=true after reviewing caps. All caps are conservative defaults for the DEMO environment (mock funds, thin books).
risk_notes: Demo books are thin: small orders can move prices; always prefer post-only resting bids.
Categorize every fill with topic + strategy tag so the portfolio page can compute per-strategy stats.
Per docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/rate_limits.md, order writes cost 10 tokens each; keep rates modest.
self_trade_prevention_type is required by the V2 order schema; 'taker_at_cross' allows resting-maker behavior with post_only=true.
